units.source_text: 约莫过了二十分钟，村里的一个年轻人，一边哼着歌一边从家门口路过。

en.t: About twenty minutes later, a young man from the village passed by the front of the house, humming a song.
Young auntie, are you going to cut grass today?
The grass is swaying in the wind!
Take up the sickle and go cut the grass!

units.source_text: ——歌声渐渐远去，阿住戴着眼镜，又看了阿民一眼。

en.t: As the singing gradually faded into the distance, Aju, wearing her glasses, looked at Amin once more.

units.source_text: 阿民只是对着油灯，伸长了腿，不停的打哈欠。

en.t: Amin merely sat facing the oil lamp, stretching out his legs and yawning again and again.
